title: Rabbi Yannai HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 23:7 and Tanchuma, Masei 5. Perhaps he is Yannai son of Rabbi Ami, who was a priest, named after his maternal grandfather, Rabbi Yannai, Rabbi Ami’s father-in-law, as in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11.

notes.text: The identification and naming after a maternal grandfather are Hyman’s tentative reconstruction.

The consulted Bamidbar Rabbah 23:7 names Rabbi Yannai HaKohen. The consulted segments at Tanchuma, Masei 5 and Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11 do not independently substantiate the naming or family reconstruction. The printed references and Hyman’s tentative identification are retained.
